mp.hilfe: Your own server for everything online: enter the address (host or wss:// URL), port and optionally the server secret — the client uses this connection for everything from the next connect on. Unencrypted (without wss://) only works on your home network.
mp.secret_hinweis: optional — only if the server requires one
mp.chip_gespeichert: Saved — applies from the next connect.
mp.chip_zurueckgesetzt: Reset — the default server applies again.
mp.test_ok: Connected! The server answered in {ms} ms.

fehler.secret_required: The server requires a server secret — please enter one.
fehler.secret_wrong: The server secret does not match.
fehler.auth_fail: Sign-in rejected — the server does not know this device (device identity invalid).
fehler.banned: This device is banned on the server.
fehler.rate_limit: Too many attempts — wait a moment and retry.
fehler.timeout: Timed out — the server did not answer.
fehler.unreachable: Server unreachable — check address and port.
fehler.gate: Unencrypted connections only on your home network — use wss:// (TLS).

dev.export_code_ok: Moving-box code copied to the clipboard.
dev.offset_aus: Clock runs in real time again.
dev.naechster_tag_ok: Skipped one day — offset now {stunden} h.
dev.taxi_ok: The taxi is at the door.
dev.lieferung_keine: No order on its way — nothing happened.
dev.geben_fehler: Nothing selected or no storage space.
